raw_definitions: Definisi : sell so. down the ~, ( colloq ), mengkhianati sso. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. large natural stream of water, sungai: The R~ Nile, Sungai Nil; 2. great flow, sungai, [ or various translations ]: a ~ of lava, sungai lava; ~s of blood will flow before the war is over, sungai darah akan mengalir sebelum peperangan tamat; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
